# Cearvol

> Cearvol is a leading provider of smart, stylish OTC hearing aids powered by NeuroFlow AI technology, offering rechargeable Bluetooth-enabled solutions like Diamond X1, Wave, and Nano models.

Cearvol specializes in over-the-counter hearing aids with 10+ years of acoustic engineering research. Their product line features advanced AI noise reduction, Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and companion mobile apps for iOS and Android, combining accessibility with modern hearing health technology.
